description: Source code for the RustValuesGenerator class, which handles Rust-specific build configuration in a build system, including target validation, crate name/type/root, and dependencies.

classes.name: RustValuesGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating Rust-specific build values and validation within the build system.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the process of validating target type and filling in Rust-specific configuration values.

methods.name: FillCrateName
methods.description: Sets the crate name for the target, defaulting to the target label if not specified.

methods.name: FillCrateType
methods.description: Determines and sets the crate type based on scope values or defaults.

methods.name: FillCrateRoot
methods.description: Sets the crate root source file, either from scope or by inferring from sources.

methods.name: FillAliasedDeps
methods.description: Processes and sets aliased dependencies for the target.
